title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian McCaffrey would have practiced if it wasn't joint practice
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said RB Christian McCaffrey would have practiced on Tuesday if it wasn't a joint practice.
items.impact: Shanahan refuted the idea that McCaffrey isn't practicing because of a contract-related issue. McCaffrey remains day-to-day.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quentin Johnston not expected to miss much time
items.desc: Chargers WR Quentin Johnston is not expected to miss much, if any, practice time.
items.impact: Johnston limped off the field during practice on Tuesday. He is day-to-day for now.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Mike Evans (quad) experiencing quad 'tightness'
items.desc: Mike Evans (quad) is experiencing some "tightness" in his quad, per HC Kyle Shanahan. It's not expected to be anything serious.
items.impact: Evans just returned from a quad injury, so further tightness and limitation isn't a great sign. It seems the team may just be taking precautions, but this is certainly sounding like it'll be something to monitor throughout at least the rest of the preseason if not afterwards.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: JuJu Smith-Schuster released by Giants
items.desc: The Giants released WR JuJu Smith-Schuster.
items.impact: Smith-Schuster had been competing for a depth role. He will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyson Bagent suffers hamstring injury
items.desc: Tyson Bagent suffered a hamstring injury in the Bears preseason game against the Browns.
items.impact: Bagent did not practice on Tuesday. His status for Saturday's preseason game is in doubt.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keon Coleman diagnosed with sprained foot/toe
items.desc: Bills WR Keon Coleman was diagnosed with a sprained foot/toe in the team's preseason opener.
items.impact: Coleman was seen in a walking boot on Tuesday. Bills head coach indicated he didn't have much concern.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zavion Thomas (knee) returns to practice
items.desc: Zavion Thomas returned to practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Thomas missed the past week with a knee injury. He is competing for a depth role in the Bears wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Biadasz (leg) carted off practice field Tuesday
items.desc: Tyler Biadasz was carted off during Tuesday's joint practice with the 49ers.
items.impact: Biadasz was unable to put weight on his leg. If he misses an extended period of time, rookie Jake Slaughter could see more opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Puka Nacua (groin) still not practicing Tuesday
items.desc: Puka Nacua remained absent from practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Nacua is still dealing with soreness in his groin. He was working out off to the side with a member of the Rams' training staff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq (hernia) expected to be ready for Week 1
items.desc: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn told reporters TE Kenyon Sadiq will be ready for Week 1.
items.impact: This was the expectation when Sadiq first went down with the injury. He likely won't make an immediate impact for fantasy managers after missing most of training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jayden Higgins leaves practice early Tuesday
items.desc: Jayden Higgins left practice early on Tuesday with an apparent injury.
items.impact: Higgins was able to get up on his own power. There should be an update on his status when available.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Maxwell Hairston (groin) returns to practice
items.desc: Maxwell Hairston returned to practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Hairston had missed time with a groin injury. He was back on the field on Tuesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeremiyah Love will not require surgery on ankle injury
items.desc: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur confirmed Jeremiyah Love will not need surgery on his injured ankle.
items.impact: Love is dealing with a high ankle sprain. He remains hopeful to be ready for the start of the season next month.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Love, Packers starters to see some snaps Friday
items.desc: Jordan Love and the Packers starters will see some snaps again in Friday's preseason game against the Broncos.
items.impact: They are expected to play at least one drive again after they also played in the preseason opener against the Steelers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. in pads at practice Tuesday
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. was in pads at practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Mims made his return to practice on Monday. He is competing for a depth role in the Broncos wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lukas Van Ness (shoulder) returns to practice
items.desc: Lukas Van Ness returned to practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Van Ness works his way back to practice after he was absent on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Benson (knee) not ready yet for team activities
items.desc: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Trey Benson is "not quite yet" ready for team activities.
items.impact: LaFleur said Benson is trending in the right direction. It remains unclear what his role is in the Cardinals backfield when healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (leg) in full pads at practice Tuesday
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle is in full pads at practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: It is another positive sign for Waddle following his return to practice on Monday. He remains on track to be good to go for the start of the regular season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Justin Herbert, Chargers starters to play one series Thursday
items.desc: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said the starters will play one series on Thursday against the 49ers.
items.impact: We will get our first look at the Chargers offense under new OC Mike McDaniel.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kaelon Black (adductor) in uniform at practice Tuesday
items.desc: Kaelon Black is in uniform at practice on Tuesday for the first time since the first week of camp.
items.impact: It is a positive sign for the Black. The rookie will have a chance to be good to go for the regular season opener.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kurtis Rourke (rib) not practicing Tuesday
items.desc: Kurtis Rourke is not practicing on Tuesday as he deals with a rib injury.
items.impact: Rourke left the 49ers preseason opener early. He was taken to the hospital before he was later released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jackson Powers-Johnson not expected to play in preseason game Thursday
items.desc: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said RG Jackson Powers-Johnson is likely out for the preseason matchup Thursday against Houston.
items.impact: Powers-Johnson left practice early on Monday. It remains unclear what he is dealing with.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Monangai (knee) considered week-to-week
items.desc: Bears coach Ben Johnson says that RB Kyle Monangai is week to week with his injury.
items.impact: Monangai was diagnosed with a hyperextended knee. His status will need to continue to be monitored as we get closer to Week 1.
